# Current Macro Themes

Report 027 | Published 2020-08-02 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-themes-2020-8-2/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/027.json)

Fiscal regimes connect asset theses.

This is the central framework statement and deserves separate scores for direction, magnitude, timing and causation. Bitcoin supplied a clear dated success. Inflation rose, but the assumed compulsory Treasury financing and low-yield ceiling failed; deficit magnitude and persistence were overstated. Gold and silver relative-performance checks were adverse. The author openly acknowledges value-rotation mistakes, while decade-level bets still require their original endpoints.

**Coverage:** All numbered text blocks and image labels read. Material theses, forecasts and explanations are included; routine holdings lists, incidental statistics, company descriptions and boilerplate are excluded. Chart pixels were not inspected.

### 027-C11

**Revenue-collapse scenario**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Wrong |
| Type | forecast |
| Horizon | 2020 and 2021 |
| Conditions | Not specified |
| Author modality | could |
| Asset or variable | US receipts |
| Source blocks | 95 |
| Thesis family | 2020-revenue-collapse |

FY 2020 receipts fell $42 bn, much less than the suggested $500 bn-or-more decrease; FY 2021 receipts instead rose to $4.046 tn. The modal could was not a guarantee, but this proposed numerical downside scenario did not materialize. Fiscal versus calendar-year wording is not explicit.

**Direction:** See reason; no return inferred.

**Timing:** Original horizon retained: 2020 and 2021

**Mechanism:** Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Outcome evidence:**

- [FY 2020 budget summary](https://www.cbo.gov/publication/56746) | CBO | 2020-11-09 | Verified in the audit

FY 2020 deficit: $3.1 tn, 14.9% of GDP. Receipts fell only $42 bn, 1%, from FY 2019. Debt changes also reflected Treasury cash accumulation.

- [FY 2022 budget results](https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/jy1043) | US Treasury | 2022-10-21 | Verified in the audit

FY 2021 deficit was $2.776 tn/12.3% GDP; FY 2022 $1.375 tn/5.5%. Receipts rose from $4.046 tn to $4.896 tn.

### 027-C14

**Fiscal solvency support**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Right |
| Type | explanation |
| Horizon | Not specified |
| Conditions | Not specified |
| Author modality | asserted |
| Asset or variable | Policy |
| Source blocks | 103, 104 |
| Thesis family | liquidity-versus-solvency |

A loan or asset swap supplies liquidity without automatically increasing recipient net worth; fiscal transfers can absorb losses or increase income. The central-bank versus fiscal balance-sheet distinction supports this mechanism, though the source later confuses reserves with capital.

**Direction:** Resolved as stated.

**Timing:** No fixed endpoint supplied.

**Mechanism:** Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Outcome evidence:**

- [How money is created](https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/explainers/how-is-money-created) | Bank of England | 2019-10-01 | Verified in the audit

Reserves are electronic central-bank settlement money. Capital is a separate resource that absorbs loan-default losses; both liquidity and capital constraints apply to banks.

- [May 2020 personal income and outlays](https://www.bea.gov/news/2020/personal-income-and-outlays-may-2020) | BEA | 2020-06-26 | Verified in the audit

Personal income fell 4.2% in May after revised 10.8% growth in April. Declining recovery payments explained much of the decrease, partly offset by unemployment benefits. Spending rose 8.2%.

Emergency purchases supported market functioning and affected term premia. Calling every yield-affecting purchase soft control makes the idea difficult to falsify; the Fed considered but did not adopt explicit caps. Low volatility alone cannot distinguish policy influence from private demand.

Investors sold longer Treasuries and MBS for liquid assets; Treasury bid-ask spreads widened and dealer balance-sheet constraints impaired intermediation. Purchases and lending aimed to restore market function.

- [July 2020 FOMC minutes](https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomcminutes20200729.htm) | Federal Reserve | 2020-08-19 | Verified in the audit

Most participants discussing yield caps/targets judged benefits modest in the prevailing environment. The committee maintained guidance and purchases without adopting explicit Treasury yield-curve control.

Large mines commissioned in 2010-19 averaged over 16 years from discovery. Ore grades deteriorated, but measured reserves grew; shortages depend on timing, investment and demand scenarios, not exhaustion alone.

- [Critical minerals executive summary](https://www.iea.org/reports/the-role-of-critical-minerals-in-clean-energy-transitions/executive-summary) | IEA | 2021-05-05 | Verified in the audit

IEA estimates EV mineral inputs at six times conventional cars and wind substantially above gas generation; technology-specific scope excludes steel/aluminium in the cited comparison.

## Verification limitations

- Retrieved 2026-11-07; publication-date wording is not authenticated.
- Public market series are available, but not every investment claim has a defined horizon or reconciled corporate-action-adjusted return. Unverified outcomes remain unscored; macro data use latest available vintages.
- Historical book/model citations and chart pixels were not independently reconstructed.
